_comment: Configuration for check_coverage.py, which is NOT part of the price scrape and
never changes a figure. It answers one question the scraper cannot: is the
catalog page still showing everything OVH actually sells?
scrape.py already fails loudly when a model it MAPS disappears from the page.
It is blind in the other direction -- a model OVH sells that the page never
mentions is, to the scraper, simply not there, and stays invisible forever. That
is not hypothetical: between 2026-08-03 and 2026-08-04 the catalog page dropped
five models it was still serving, and the only reason anyone noticed was a human
comparing a cached browser tab against a fresh one.
The comparison is against OVH's own OpenAI-compatible model list, which is public
and needs no key -- the same 'no credentials, ever' rule as every fetch here.
It is used ONLY to compare the sets of model ids. Its prices are deliberately
never read: they are quoted in USD while providers.ovh publishes EUR, and they
are different numbers rather than the same price in another format.
'ignore' lists ids that are expected to appear on one side and not the other,
with the reason, because a check that reports the same non-problem every week is
a check everyone learns to skip. Each entry is a claim a human made and can
re-check; keep them few and keep the reasons concrete.

ignore.ppl: Not a published model. Appears in the API list with no price, no context length and no catalog entry; verified 2026-08-04.
ignore.stabilityai/stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0: The upstream Hugging Face name for the same weights the catalog lists as stable-diffusion-xl-base-v10, which IS published. Two API ids, one model.
ignore.nvr-tts-en-us: Text-to-speech is served from its own per-model endpoint, not the OpenAI-compatible one, so it is on the catalog page but never in this API list.
ignore.nvr-tts-de-de: Same as nvr-tts-en-us: text-to-speech is not served over the OpenAI-compatible API.
ignore.nvr-tts-es-es: Same as nvr-tts-en-us: text-to-speech is not served over the OpenAI-compatible API.
ignore.nvr-tts-it-it: Same as nvr-tts-en-us: text-to-speech is not served over the OpenAI-compatible API.
